text:
lana-docs: Quick heads up — I opened a tiny docs PR to update the tracehook example used in the Console dashboard cost panel. The snippet still uses `tracekey` (old param) and the "preset" link in the example 404s. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8123
jess-eng: Thanks for flagging. Do you want me to patch the snippet directly in that PR or send a follow-up? I can also run a quick link sweep for other dashboard examples.
omar-ml: FYI the runtime now returns `traceId` in the API shape for the hosted route; if docs keep `tracekey` we risk confusing users.
kevin-sdk: I can update the Node + Python snippets to match `traceId` after the docs patch. Also can drop a one-liner showing how to attach it to tracehook: `tracehook.add({ traceId: payload.traceId })`
maya-ux: Small nit: the panel label currently says "Cost by tracekey" — we should change to "Cost by trace" or "Cost by trace ID" so it reads naturally in the UI. If we change label text we should include that in the screenshot alt text.
lana-docs: Good call, @maya-ux — I'll update the panel label and alt text in the PR. @jess-eng go ahead and patch the snippet inline; @kevin-sdk please add the updated SDK examples as a follow-up commit.
jess-eng: Patch pushed: fixed param -> `traceId`, replaced broken preset link with canonical presets doc, updated code fence examples. CI hook shows one broken link left in playground example, marking it for sweep.
deploy-bot: CI result for PR #8123 — checks/links: 5 passed, 1 failed (playground/examples.md: line 82).
kevin-sdk: Pushed sdk-snippet update (node + py) in the same branch — simplified the example to: ````js
// attach trace id to tracehook
tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, cost: payload.estimatedCost })
````

and in Python:
````py
# attach trace id to tracehook
tracehook.record({"traceId": payload["traceId"], "cost": payload["estimated_cost"]})
````
maya-ux: Looks good. One wording tweak: use "estimated cost" in the UI copy.
lana-docs: Thanks team — I'll fix the last playground link and merge once CI is green. Leaving this thread open for any downstream snippet owners. :thumbsup:
